About us

Our vision at Bring! is to simplify grocery shopping for millions of people all over the world and to connect them with our partners from FMCG and retail.

What We Value: Our values guide our decisions and form the foundation of how we work together.

1. We Reach for the Stars ✨

We have high ambitions, appreciating our achievements while striving for continuous growth through change.

2. Only Together We Can Win 👫

We need everyone's best performance to reach our goals, celebrating each success as a team.

3. We Take Responsibility 🙌

Everyone bears responsibility, striving for a positive impact while helping others do the same.

4. We Trust 💙

We support each other and believe in open communication and inclusive decision-making.

Mission

We simplify shopping 🛍️🛒 for millions!

With millions of users worldwide, we simplify shopping globally through our apps, Bring! and Profital. We also connect brands and retailers with their customers by offering a targeted advertising platform. Bring! Labs operates from Switzerland (Zurich & Basel) and Germany (Berlin) and is constantly growing.

Ready to start your future with us? Join Us at Bring! Labs!
